prompt:
PLAN 04 | SHOTS 09-11 | THE CAPTURE
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 3 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_MUSICIAN = {{CHAR_MUSICIAN}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_CAPTURE. The door is open. Shahrnaz stands left, cat supported by both forearms against her chest. Arnavaz stands nearer the doorway on the right. A takes Shahrnaz’s left upper sleeve; B takes Arnavaz’s right forearm; C approaches her left side. The musician and broken instrument remain by the wall.

SHOT 09 | 00:00-00:05 | SHAHRNAZ CLOSES INWARD
40mm tight handheld medium shot. A grips Shahrnaz by the fabric of her left upper arm. She takes one backward step and turns her torso to shield the cat, both forearms still supporting it. Her shoulders lock and her head drops; A pulls her toward the exit.
SHOT 10 | 00:05-00:11 | ARNAVAZ PUSHES BACK
Cut to 28mm hip-height beside Arnavaz. She braces both feet and pushes B’s chest away with her left palm while he holds her right forearm. C reaches her left upper arm from behind. The camera shifts with her attempt to turn toward Shahrnaz, retaining all three bodies in readable overlap.
SHOT 11 | 00:11-00:15 | THE JAMB
Cut to 50mm at the open doorway. A and Shahrnaz pass first, cat visible against her chest. Arnavaz briefly hooks her left fingers around the jamb; C peels that hand away while B draws her forward. Cut on the hand releasing stone. The musician and broken instrument stay inside.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Preserve warm window light and the narrow cold doorway spill. Focus follows grasping hands and body weight rather than facial expressions.
SOUND
Sleeves under tension, scraping soles, short breaths, palm against stone, the cat’s quiet breathing. The sound remains close and dry.
END STATE AND EDIT
A escorts Shahrnaz through the doorway first; she still supports the living cat. B and C control Arnavaz’s upper arms behind them. Her left hand has just lost contact with the door jamb.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

PLAN 04 | SHOTS 09A–09E | THE SISTERS ARE SEIZED

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Horizontal 16:9.
Exactly five shots, each lasting three seconds.

This sequence begins after the intrusion and the breaking of the instrument. The dramatic action is the violent seizure of the sisters and their forced movement toward the open doorway.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Guard A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
Guard B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
Guard C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
Musician = {{CHAR_MUSICIAN}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
The sisters’ private room = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}

PROP REFERENCE:
Broken instrument = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN}}

Preserve all referenced identities, sculptural masks, costumes, body proportions, animal design and room geometry.

START STATE:

The door is already open.
The instrument is already broken beside the musician, who remains seated against the wall.

Shahrnaz stands left, holding the frightened cat securely against her chest.
Arnavaz stands to her right, between her sister and Guard B.
A reaches for Shahrnaz.
B confronts Arnavaz.
C moves from the musician toward Arnavaz’s other side.

Shahrnaz’s objective is to protect the cat and resist being pulled away.
Arnavaz’s objective is to break through the guards and reach her sister.
The guards’ objective is to separate and forcibly remove them.

SHOT 09A | 00:00–00:03 | THE FIRST PULL

24mm close handheld at Shahrnaz’s chest height.

A clamps her left upper arm and pulls her sharply toward the doorway.

Shahrnaz twists against his grip and plants one foot. Her upper body curves around the cat while both forearms continue supporting it.

The cat flattens its ears and squirms against her chest. She shifts one hand beneath its hindquarters and turns her shoulder between the animal and A.

The camera is pulled into the movement, stepping sideways with an abrupt bodily jolt. Keep her gripping hands, the cat and A’s restraining hand clearly focused.

Cut while she is still resisting the pull.

SHOT 09B | 00:03–00:06 | ARNAVAZ REACHES HER SISTER

24mm tight handheld beside Arnavaz, with Shahrnaz visible just beyond B’s shoulder.

Seeing her sister pulled away, Arnavaz knocks B’s reaching hand aside and lunges through the opening toward Shahrnaz.

Her fingertips catch Shahrnaz’s upper arm for an instant.

B catches Arnavaz’s right upper arm and pulls her backward. Her hand slides off her sister’s clothing.

The camera surges sideways with her attempted breakthrough, then jolts back as B stops her.

Keep both sisters and the separating hands readable within the same close composition.

SHOT 09C | 00:06–00:09 | TWO GUARDS AGAINST ARNAVAZ

28mm handheld at waist height, close enough to feel trapped among the three bodies.

B holds Arnavaz’s right upper arm.
C catches her left upper arm from behind.

Arnavaz drops her weight, plants her feet and twists hard toward Shahrnaz. B has to widen his stance; C steps closer to keep his grip.

She tries to wrench one shoulder free and drive forward again. Both guards pull her arms apart just enough to arrest the turn and force her back toward the exit.

The camera dips with her lowered weight and makes a rough lateral correction around C’s shoulder.

Her resistance visibly forces both men to work.

SHOT 09D | 00:09–00:12 | SHAHRNAZ SHELTERS THE CAT

28mm close handheld retreating ahead of Shahrnaz.

A continues hauling her toward the open door. She takes two stumbling sideways steps, trying to look back at Arnavaz while keeping her torso turned protectively around the cat.

The cat presses low into her arms, ears flattened. Shahrnaz steadies it with a quick adjustment and brings her masked cheek close to its head.

Another pull from A interrupts the comforting gesture. She braces again, breath catching, hands maintaining their support.

Behind her, Arnavaz continues straining against B and C.

Keep the foreground struggle and her sister’s resistance in deep focus. The camera retreats with uneven, urgent footfalls.

SHOT 09E | 00:12–00:15 | THE DOOR JAMB

24mm close handheld immediately inside the doorway.

A forces Shahrnaz across the threshold first, the cat still sheltered against her chest.

B and C bring Arnavaz behind her. Arnavaz catches the jamb with her left hand and leans backward, trying to stop them and turn toward her sister.

C uses his free hand to peel her fingers from the stone while maintaining his upper-arm grip. B pulls her forward from the other side.

The camera shifts roughly from her braced hand to her twisting shoulders, staying close and fully focused.

End as her fingers lose contact with the jamb and her body is pulled through the doorway.

CAMERA AND FOCUS:

Continuous reactive handheld movement throughout all five shots.

Use close wide-angle framing and deep depth of field. Keep the sisters, restraining hands and nearby guards sharply readable together. Maintain focus through the sudden movements.

Camera shake comes from hurried footfalls, recoil, changing balance and bodies forcing the operator aside. Brief motion blur accompanies the hardest jolts; each recovery immediately reveals the next action.

Cut on force: a pull, a reaching hand, a blocked turn, a stumble, fingers losing their grip.

Maintain the same side of the movement axis, with travel consistently directed toward the open doorway.

PERFORMANCE:

Shahrnaz remains frightened and physically active. She braces, twists, stumbles and shields the cat while trying to stay near her sister.

Arnavaz repeatedly attempts to reach Shahrnaz. Her resistance continues across cuts through planted feet, sudden changes of direction, forceful shoulder turns and reaching hands.

B and C restrain Arnavaz together. Their changing footing and tightening grips show the effort required.

Emotion remains visible through posture, breath, hands and physical weight beneath the established masks.

LIGHT AND SOUND:

Preserve the room’s warm available light and colder spill through the doorway. Moving bodies interrupt the light while surface detail remains readable.

Close diegetic sound: strained breathing, scraping soles, boots changing stance, fabric pulled tight, fingers dragging over stone, one frightened cat sound and the shifting resonance of the open corridor.

Carry the struggle continuously across every cut.

END STATE:

Shahrnaz has crossed into the corridor with A, still securely supporting the living cat.

B and C force Arnavaz through behind them, each controlling one upper arm. Her left hand has just released the jamb.

The musician and broken instrument remain inside the room.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Musician (CHR-006 V02); match it wherever Musician appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Jamshid Daughters Chamber (LOC-020 V01); match it wherever Jamshid Daughters Chamber appears.
<<<image_7>>> is Instrument Saz (PRP-018 V01); match it wherever Instrument Saz appears.
